title: MF-01 A CRM Admin profile gives module and field administration inside Desk

panels.caption: Desk Agent (+ CRM Admin in CRM) opens Setup → Modules and Fields
Agent profile (docs)
text: Only users whose profile has the "Customize" / Setup permission can open Modules and Tabs or Layouts and Fields. An Agent profile cannot.

rows.tavi: Desk Agent in Desk, CRM Admin in CRM

notes: GET /api/v1/iam/me/permissions (x-app-key desk) returns CRM Admin metadata permissions such as metadata.modules.manage.
